variants.a: root pawn capture or immediate recapture of the actual moved piece
variants.b: allow the same early recapture elsewhere, including ply five
variants.c: linked exchanges plus a bounded wait for material to settle
variants.d: broader early recaptures plus the same bounded settlement window

independence: The initial sample is independent for A/B and development for C/D. The reserve is independent for all four arms.
scope: Actual classical move mistake. One engine-assisted reviewer per case. Frozen positional, tactical and mixed axes keep uncertain labels.
engine: Same legal Stockfish 19 paired root lines, separate reply searches and shared replies for all arms. No extra engine queries.
